comment: What Neyvia can install or keep current on this PC. components_status_command merges this with live state. Groups are the onboarding sections: core, claude-mod, codex-skills, optional.

components.title: Neyvia core runtime
components.summary: The private Python environment Neyvia's backend runs in. Re-synced automatically when an update changes its pinned packages.
components.updatePath: Applied by the desktop app before the backend starts; checks the SHA-256 of the bundled backend-requirements.txt.

components.title: Add Neyvia to my Claude Code
components.summary: Installs Neyvia's plugin into your own Claude Code: Neyvia's tools, manuals, live status and the optional stop gate, on your plan limits.
unlocks: Claude Code driven and watched from Neyvia
needs: Claude Code installed on this PC
components.updatePath: Refreshed with each Neyvia update; run /reload-plugins in a running Claude Code, or restart it.

components.title: Neyvia skills for Codex
components.summary: Copies Neyvia's Codex skills into your Codex skills folder as neyvia-* and keeps them current. Your own skills are never touched.
unlocks: Neyvia's design, review and image skills inside Codex
needs: Codex installed on this PC (a skills folder is created if missing)
components.updatePath: Refreshed with each Neyvia update. Only folders Neyvia installed (marked .neyvia-skill.json) are changed.

components.title: LAYA model weights
components.summary: The local LAYA model that lets Neyvia see apps and answer routine decisions without the big model.
components.updatePath: Version check only. The weights are referenced in place from config/laya.json and are never downloaded by Neyvia tonight.

components.title: Dictation engine
components.summary: Local speech to text (Phonon-2) used by the voice button.
components.updatePath: Version check only. The engine lives in its own folder; update it there (git pull) and restart it from Neyvia.

components.title: Godot, Unity and Blender bridges
components.summary: Editor add-ons that let Neyvia look at and drive a game project.
components.updatePath: Version check only. Copy the add-on again from this build when its version here is newer than the one in your project.

components.title: Neyvia desktop updates
components.summary: Where the desktop app looks for new releases.
components.updatePath: Release endpoint check. The slim installer has no self-update; it receives updates through the signed base pack.
